credibility.summary: Management consistently meets or exceeds its margin and volume growth promises, adhering closely to its guided 20%-24% EBITDA corridor.

narrative_vs_numbers: Margin guidance of 20%-24% aligns closely with actual quarterly OPM numbers ranging between 20% and 26%.
Management narrative of double-digit volume momentum is supported by reported 11% H1 FY27 UVG.
Reported FY26 revenue growth of 11.1% supports the medium-term top-line growth confidence voiced by management.

calls.tone: Confident in volume growth momentum and margin resilience despite raw material volatility.
